units: metric, raw weights; 1 tsp olive oil = 5 g

recipes.name: Yogurt, oats & pomegranate
recipes.method: Stir the oats into the yogurt 10 minutes ahead (or the night before). Top with pomegranate and honey.

recipes.name: Spinach egg scramble + toast
recipes.method: Wilt the spinach in the oil for 1 minute, add the beaten eggs and stir on low heat for 2 minutes. Season with oregano and pepper.

recipes.name: Overnight oats, pear & walnuts
recipes.method: Mix everything except the walnuts in a jar the night before. Top with walnuts in the morning.

recipes.name: Feta-tomato omelette + toast
recipes.method: Cook the eggs for 3 minutes, add tomato and crumbled feta, fold and cook 1 minute more.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese & tomato toast
recipes.method: Toast the bread. Serve with the cheese and sliced veg dressed with oil and oregano.

recipes.name: Skyr bowl, kiwi & walnuts
recipes.method: Stir the oats into the skyr. Top with sliced kiwi and walnuts.

recipes.name: Chicken, bulgur & village salad
ingredients: 1 tomato, ½ cucumber, ¼ red onion, ½ green pepper
recipes.method: Grill the chicken 5–6 minutes per side (or use Sunday’s batch). Simmer the bulgur in double its volume of water for 12 minutes. Chop and dress the salad.

recipes.name: Fakes with feta
recipes.method: Simmer everything except the oil and vinegar in 700 ml water for 35–40 minutes. Stir in the oil and vinegar at the end; crumble feta on top. Batch 4 portions.

recipes.name: Tuna-yogurt wrap + apple
ingredients: 1 can tuna in water (120 g drained)
recipes.method: Mix tuna, yogurt, mustard and lemon. Wrap with the vegetables. Apple on the side.

recipes.name: Chicken & broccoli stir-fry
ingredients: 200 g broccoli, red pepper and carrot
recipes.method: Boil the rice. Stir-fry the chicken on high for 5 minutes, add the veg for 4 minutes, soy at the end.

recipes.name: Chickpea & tuna salad
recipes.method: Toss everything together. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.name: Turkey sandwich + skyr
recipes.method: Assemble the sandwich; skyr on the side.

recipes.name: Baked salmon, roast cauliflower-broccoli, potato
recipes.method: Roast the veg and potato cubes at 200 °C for 25 minutes. Add the salmon for the last 12–14 minutes.

recipes.name: Grilled sea bream, horta, potato
ingredients: 150 g sea bream fillet (or a 300 g whole fish)
recipes.method: Boil the horta and potato. Grill the fish 3–4 minutes per side. Dress with oil and lemon.

recipes.name: Chicken souvlaki, tzatziki, pita
ingredients: 80 g tzatziki (2% yogurt, cucumber, garlic, dill, ½ tsp oil)
recipes.method: Marinate 15 minutes or more. Skewer and grill or pan-cook 10–12 minutes, turning. Warm the pita.

recipes.name: Lean beef patty, roast pumpkin, salad
recipes.method: Roast the pumpkin at 200 °C for 25 minutes. Shape and pan-sear the patty 4 minutes per side.
recipes.trainingDayTopUp: +100 g potato with the pumpkin (+75 kcal)

recipes.name: Garides saganaki with orzo
recipes.method: Simmer garlic and tomato for 8 minutes. Add the prawns for 3 minutes, crumble feta on top. Serve over boiled orzo.

recipes.name: Turkey keftedakia & pasta
ingredients: Grated onion, parsley, mint, 1 egg white
recipes.method: Shape 8 balls and bake at 200 °C for 18 minutes. Finish 5 minutes in simmering sauce. Serve on the pasta. Batch 2–3 portions.

recipes.name: Vegetable & feta frittata
ingredients: 150 g courgette, pepper, spinach and leek
recipes.method: Sauté the veg 5 minutes in an ovenproof pan. Pour in the eggs, crumble feta, bake at 180 °C for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Lemon chicken traybake
recipes.method: Toss everything on one tray and roast at 200 °C for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Grilled sardines, horta, bread
ingredients: 150 g cleaned fresh sardines (or tinned in water)
recipes.method: Grill or pan-sear the sardines 3 minutes per side. Serve with boiled horta and lemon.

recipes.name: Chicken avgolemono soup
recipes.method: Poach the chicken with the veg in 800 ml water for 20 minutes; shred. Cook the rice in the broth for 15 minutes. Whisk egg and lemon, temper with hot broth, stir in off the heat. Return the chicken.

recipes.name: Poached eggs, avocado toast + skyr
recipes.method: Poach the eggs 3 minutes in barely simmering water. Mash avocado with lemon on the toast, top with eggs and tomatoes.

recipes.name: Kayianas (tomato eggs) + toast
recipes.method: Cook the grated tomato in the oil 5 minutes until thick. Add the beaten eggs and stir gently 2 minutes; crumble feta on top.

recipes.name: Apple-cinnamon porridge
recipes.method: Simmer oats, milk and apple 4–5 minutes, stirring. Top with skyr, walnuts and cinnamon.

recipes.name: Smoked salmon & cottage cheese toast
recipes.method: Toast the bread, spread with cottage cheese, top with salmon, cucumber and dill. Orange on the side.

recipes.name: Banana-oat pancakes
recipes.method: Blend banana, eggs and oats. Cook 4 small pancakes in a non-stick pan, 2 minutes per side. Top with skyr and cinnamon.

recipes.name: Tahini-honey yogurt with pear
recipes.method: Swirl tahini and honey into the yogurt; top with pear and oats.

recipes.name: Mushroom, spinach & cheese omelette
recipes.method: Sauté mushrooms 4 minutes, add spinach until wilted. Pour in eggs, add cheese, fold after 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese, pomegranate & walnut bowl
recipes.method: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl; top with fruit, walnuts and honey.

recipes.name: Village plate: eggs, feta, tomato + skyr
recipes.method: Boil eggs 9 minutes (batch on Sunday). Plate with feta, sliced veg and bread; skyr on the side.

recipes.name: Black-eyed pea & tuna salad
recipes.method: Toss beans, tuna, chopped herbs and tomato with oil and lemon. Orange after.

recipes.name: Chicken gyro-style pita
ingredients: Side salad with 1 tsp olive oil
recipes.method: Season the chicken and pan-sear 5–6 minutes. Fill the warm pita with chicken, tzatziki, tomato and onion.

recipes.name: Quinoa, chicken & roast pumpkin bowl
recipes.method: Roast pumpkin at 200 °C for 25 minutes; simmer quinoa 12 minutes. Slice grilled chicken over rocket, quinoa and pumpkin; crumble feta.

recipes.name: Tuna, egg & potato salad
recipes.method: Boil potatoes and beans; cool. Combine with tuna, halved eggs, tomato and olives; dress with oil, mustard and vinegar.

recipes.name: One-pot chicken kritharoto
recipes.method: Brown chicken and onion in the oil 5 minutes. Add passata and 250 ml water, then orzo; simmer 12 minutes, stirring. Finish with cheese.

recipes.name: Turkey, hummus & veg wrap + skyr
recipes.method: Spread hummus on the tortilla, add turkey, pepper and rocket; roll. Skyr on the side.

recipes.name: Spanakorizo with poached eggs
recipes.method: Soften leek in the oil, add spinach and rice with 200 ml water; simmer 18 minutes. Finish with dill and lemon; top with poached eggs and feta.

recipes.name: Lean beef & bean chili
recipes.method: Brown beef with onion, pepper and spices 6 minutes. Add passata and beans; simmer 15 minutes. Serve with rice. Batch 3 portions.

recipes.name: Yogurt chicken-salad sandwich + apple
recipes.method: Mix chicken, yogurt, chopped celery and mustard. Fill the sandwich with lettuce. Apple on the side.

recipes.name: Bakaliaros plaki (baked cod)
recipes.method: Bake potato, veg and oil at 200 °C for 25 minutes. Lay the cod on top and bake 12–15 minutes more.

recipes.name: Pork tenderloin, roast apple & cabbage
recipes.method: Rub pork with mustard and thyme; sear 3 minutes. Roast with apple, cabbage and potato at 200 °C for 20 minutes; rest 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Turkey-stuffed peppers
recipes.method: Mix mince, rice, tomato, onion and herbs; fill the peppers. Bake covered at 190 °C for 35 minutes, uncovered 10 more with feta on top.

recipes.name: Fasolakia with grilled chicken
recipes.method: Simmer beans, tomato, onion and oil with a splash of water 25 minutes. Grill the chicken 5 minutes per side and serve alongside.
recipes.trainingDayTopUp: +100 g potato in the beans (+75 kcal)

recipes.name: Turkey steak, lemon potatoes & horta
recipes.method: Roast potatoes with half the oil, lemon and oregano at 200 °C for 30 minutes. Pan-sear turkey 4 minutes per side. Serve with boiled horta and the rest of the oil.

recipes.name: Pumpkin-spice overnight oats
recipes.method: Mix everything except the walnuts in a jar the night before. Top with walnuts in the morning.

recipes.name: Baked cinnamon pear & yogurt
recipes.method: Bake the pear halves with cinnamon at 190 °C for 20 minutes (or batch the night before). Serve warm over yogurt with oats and walnuts.

recipes.name: Leek & feta egg muffins
recipes.method: Soften the leek in the oil 5 minutes. Whisk eggs, add leek, feta and dill; pour into 3 muffin cups and bake at 180 °C for 18 minutes. Batch a tray for 3 days.

recipes.name: Sweet potato & egg hash
recipes.method: Pan-fry the sweet potato in the oil with a splash of water, covered, 8 minutes. Add spinach, make wells, crack in the eggs, cover 4 minutes. Dollop of skyr.

recipes.name: Quince-cinnamon skyr bowl
recipes.method: Poach quince slices with cinnamon in water 25 minutes (batch for the week). Spoon over skyr with oats, walnuts and honey.

recipes.name: Mushroom, thyme & egg toast
ingredients: 100 g low-fat cottage cheese or anthotyro
recipes.method: Sauté mushrooms with thyme in the oil 5 minutes; fry or poach the egg. Spread cheese on toast, top with mushrooms and egg. Kiwi on the side.

recipes.name: Roast pumpkin, lentil & chicken salad
recipes.method: Roast pumpkin at 200 °C for 25 minutes; simmer lentils 20 minutes. Toss warm with rocket, sliced chicken and feta; dress.

recipes.name: Chicken, mushroom & barley soup
recipes.method: Soften veg and mushrooms in the oil, add barley, chicken and 900 ml water; simmer 35 minutes. Shred chicken back in; cheese on top. Batch 3 portions.

recipes.name: Lean lahanodolmades avgolemono
recipes.method: Mix mince, rice, onion and herbs; roll in cabbage leaves. Simmer covered in water 40 minutes. Whisk egg and lemon, temper with hot broth, pour over off the heat. Batch 3 portions.

recipes.name: Sweet potato, chicken & tahini bowl
ingredients: 10 g tahini + 50 g Greek yogurt + lemon
recipes.method: Roast sweet potato and broccoli at 200 °C for 25 minutes. Slice grilled chicken over rocket and veg; whisk the tahini-yogurt dressing and drizzle.

recipes.name: Fasolada with sardines
ingredients: 90 g tinned sardines in water or grilled fresh
recipes.method: Simmer beans with veg and tomato 60–75 minutes (or pressure-cook 25). Stir in the oil at the end. Serve with sardines on the side, Greek-style. Batch 4 portions.

recipes.name: Chicken, apple & walnut salad
recipes.method: Grill and slice the chicken. Toss leaves, celery and apple with the yogurt-mustard dressing; top with chicken and walnuts.

recipes.name: Chicken with chestnuts & onions
ingredients: Splash of wine or stock, cinnamon stick, bay leaf
recipes.method: Brown chicken and onions in the oil 5 minutes. Add chestnuts, liquid and spices; cover and simmer 25 minutes. Salad on the side.

recipes.name: Pork & quince stew
recipes.method: Brown pork and onion, add quince, potato, spices and 200 ml water; simmer covered 30 minutes. Salad on the side.

recipes.name: Beef & mushroom giouvetsi
ingredients: 120 g lean beef (5%), cubed or mince
recipes.method: Brown beef and mushrooms, add tomato and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in orzo and 250 ml hot water; bake at 190 °C for 20 minutes. Cheese on top.

recipes.name: One-pan cod with leeks & lemon
recipes.method: Soften leeks and potato in the oil, covered, 12 minutes. Lay cod on top, add lemon and dill, cover 8–10 minutes until it flakes.

recipes.name: Turkey, pumpkin & chickpea stew
recipes.method: Brown turkey with spices, add pumpkin, chickpeas, tomato and 150 ml water; simmer 20 minutes. Serve over bulgur.

recipes.name: Grilled mackerel, beetroot & horta
recipes.method: Grill mackerel 3–4 minutes per side. Serve with beetroot, boiled horta dressed with oil and lemon, and bread.

recipes.name: Roast chestnuts + skyr
recipes.method: Good before either session.

recipes.name: Baked apple with skyr
recipes.method: Best before lifting.

recipes.name: Pomegranate skyr
recipes.method: Best before lifting.

recipes.name: Dried figs & mandarins
recipes.method: Fast carbs — best before basketball.

recipes.name: Pear & cottage cheese
recipes.method: Best before lifting.

recipes.name: Rice cakes, tahini & honey + banana
recipes.method: Best before basketball.

recipes.method: Best before lifting.

recipes.name: Skyr, rice cakes & honey
recipes.method: Best before lifting.

recipes.method: Best before basketball.
